category_title: EFL children with learning difficulties exhibiting behavioral disengagement and low motivation
minimal_context: The student is using the VoiceThread online system to review summary sentences and record their own reading.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time to review the summary sentences on the VoiceThread page and record your own reading.

STUDENT: I don't want to do it. I am afraid of my regular English class.

TUTOR: Let's just look at the sentences on the screen together.

STUDENT: (Looks away from the screen) I have no interest in this storytelling.

TUTOR: Please click the button so we can start the recording practice.

STUDENT: No! I will not come if I have to do recording.

options.A: Approach the situation from an affective lens. Share that you were also gifted in English, discuss the benefits of this trait, and ask if he is satisfied with purposefully not utilizing his gift for the VoiceThread recording.
options.B: Upload the storylines and pictures to VoiceThread as visual aids, then record the reading of the story for the student to listen to as many times as needed.
options.C: Acknowledge the use of pictures on VoiceThread as a strategy, then guide the student to separate and chunk the summary sentences together before attempting the recording.
options.D: Use direct self-disclosure of a parallel personal struggle (e.g., a traumatic experience in a past English class) to establish a deep emotional connection before attempting the VoiceThread recording.
